lines.beaver: 박 박사님, 요즘 경기가 왜 이렇게 나쁩니까?
lines.beaver_en: Dr. Park, why is the economy so bad these days?
lines.beaver_roman: Bak baksanim, yojeum gyeonggiga wae ireoke nappeumnikka?
lines.learner: 금리가 크게 올랐기에 자금이 돌지 않습니다.
lines.en: Since interest rates rose sharply, funds aren't circulating.
lines.roman: Geumniga keuge ollatgie jageumi dolji anseumnida.

lines.en: Since investors fear losses, stock prices fell.

lines.learner: 네, 기업들이 사람을 덜 뽑기에 실업률도 높습니다.
lines.en: Yes, since companies hire fewer people, unemployment is high.
lines.roman: Ne, gieopdeuri sarameul deol ppopgie sireomnyuldo nopseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: What about the value of the won?
lines.en: The won weakened, so import prices went up.

lines.beaver_en: Then it must affect prices too.
lines.learner: 네, 도매가가 먼저 올라서 소매가도 올랐습니다.
lines.en: Yes, wholesale prices rose first, so retail prices rose too.
lines.roman: Ne, domaekkaga meonjeo ollaseo somaekkado ollatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Where are investors moving their money?
lines.learner: 불안하기에 금 같은 안전 자산에 투자합니다.
lines.en: Since they're anxious, they invest in safe assets like gold.
lines.roman: Buranhagie geum gateun anjeon jasane tujahamnida.

lines.beaver: 그럼 금으로 이득을 본 사람도 있겠군요.
lines.beaver_en: Then some people must have profited from gold.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom geumeuro ideugeul bon saramdo itgetgunyo.
lines.learner: 네, 금값이 올라서 이득을 본 투자자가 많습니다.
lines.en: Yes, gold rose, so many investors made a profit.
lines.roman: Ne, geumgapsi ollaseo ideugeul bon tujajaga manseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: On the other hand, who has suffered losses?
lines.en: Since spending fell, companies' losses grew too.

lines.beaver_en: What's needed to revive the economy?
lines.learner: 금리를 낮춰서 경제 활성화를 도와야 합니다.
lines.en: We should lower interest rates to help revitalize the economy.
lines.roman: Geumnireul nachwoseo gyeongje hwalseonghwareul dowaya hamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the great explanation. I'll put it in the report.
lines.learner: 네, 자금 흐름도 계속 같이 보겠습니다.
lines.en: Sure, let's keep watching the flow of funds together.
lines.roman: Ne, jageum heureumdo gyesok gachi bogetseumnida.
